lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular spots are arranged in a structured grid pattern posterior to the gills. Clusters are distributed in roughly five horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns, creating a geometric matrix across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity (faint white bars) intersect with horizontal arrangements of spots to form a checkerboard-like grid of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges (carinae) are visible along the upper flank. The primary lateral ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal edge and a defined shadow cast on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible surface of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance spots, with approximately 8-10 distinct blobs scattered across the lower and middle portions of the fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, white, linear feature (likely a macro-parasite) is attached to the posterior ventral surface near the pectoral fin base. Minor irregular nicks are visible on the trailing edges of the pectoral and dorsal fins.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) positioned ventrally below the pectoral fin and along the lower abdominal region.
